Below are the courses I have taught over the years and material related to courses I'm currently teaching. Links to course materials are provided when available.

# For Current Students

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import html
import yaml
from IPython.display import Markdown

candidates = [
    Path("pages/Teaching/data/courses.yml"),
    Path("data/courses.yml"),
    Path("courses.yml"),
]
course_file = next((p for p in candidates if p.exists()), None)
if course_file is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError("courses.yml not found")

with course_file.open(encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    courses = yaml.safe_load(fh) or []


def escape(value):
    return html.escape(str(value)) if value is not None else ""


def render_course_title(course):
    code = escape(course.get("course_code", ""))
    title = escape(course.get("title", ""))
    course_text = f"{code}: {title}" if code else title
    href = str(course.get("course_url", "")).strip()
    if href and href != "#":
        return f'<a href="{escape(href)}">{course_text}</a>'
    return course_text


def render_links(links):
    rendered = []
    for link in links or []:
        label = escape(link.get("label", "Link"))
        href = str(link.get("href", "")).strip()
        if not href or href == "#":
            rendered.append(label)
        else:
            rendered.append(f'<a href="{escape(href)}">{label}</a>')
    return " | ".join(rendered)


current_courses = [c for c in courses if str(c.get("status", "")).lower() == "current"]

lines = ['<div class="teaching-list teaching-section">']
for course in current_courses:
    term = escape(course.get("term", ""))
    title_html = render_course_title(course)
    links_html = render_links(course.get("links", []))

    lines.append("<li>")
    lines.append(f'<div class="teaching-year">{term}</div>')
    lines.append('<div class="course-entry">')
    lines.append(title_html)
    if links_html:
        lines.append(f'<div class="course-meta">{links_html}</div>')
    lines.append("</div>")
    lines.append("</li>")
lines.append("</div>")

Markdown("\n".join(lines))
```

# Course Archive

```{python}
from collections import OrderedDict
from pathlib import Path
import html
import yaml
from IPython.display import Markdown

candidates = [
    Path("pages/Teaching/data/courses.yml"),
    Path("data/courses.yml"),
    Path("courses.yml"),
]
course_file = next((p for p in candidates if p.exists()), None)
if course_file is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError("courses.yml not found")

with course_file.open(encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    courses = yaml.safe_load(fh) or []


def escape(value):
    return html.escape(str(value)) if value is not None else ""


def slugify(text):
    return "-".join(str(text).strip().lower().split())


def render_course_title(course):
    code = escape(course.get("course_code", ""))
    title = escape(course.get("title", ""))
    course_text = f"{code}: {title}" if code else title
    href = str(course.get("course_url", "")).strip()
    if href and href != "#":
        return f'<a href="{escape(href)}">{course_text}</a>'
    return course_text


def render_links(links):
    rendered = []
    for link in links or []:
        label = escape(link.get("label", "Link"))
        href = str(link.get("href", "")).strip()
        if not href or href == "#":
            rendered.append(label)
        else:
            rendered.append(f'<a href="{escape(href)}">{label}</a>')
    return " | ".join(rendered)


archive_courses = [c for c in courses if str(c.get("status", "")).lower() != "current"]
by_institution = OrderedDict()
for course in archive_courses:
    institution = str(course.get("institution", "Other")).strip() or "Other"
    by_institution.setdefault(institution, []).append(course)

lines = []
for institution, entries in by_institution.items():
    institution_slug = slugify(institution)
    lines.append(f'### {escape(institution)} {{#{institution_slug}}}')
    lines.append('<div class="teaching-container">')
    lines.append('<div class="teaching-list teaching-section">')

    for course in entries:
        term = escape(course.get("term", ""))
        title_html = render_course_title(course)
        links_html = render_links(course.get("links", []))

        lines.append("<li>")
        lines.append(f'<div class="teaching-year">{term}</div>')
        lines.append('<div class="course-entry">')
        lines.append(title_html)
        if links_html:
            lines.append(f'<div class="course-meta">{links_html}</div>')
        lines.append("</div>")
        lines.append("</li>")

    lines.append("</div>")
    lines.append("</div>")
    lines.append("")

Markdown("\n".join(lines))
```
